manifest.sampling: 12 fresh balanced minimal pairs: 6 as_of and 6 until; contexts and timestamps are distinct from all three served prior manifests; fixed before tokenizer calls; deterministic and without outcome-based inclusion.
manifest.method: Using ainglish.measure.token_delta with tiktoken cl100k_base and o200k_base: tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) per pair; value is the worst-tokenizer mean; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum across every per-pair delta. Both arms carry the same evidence-epoch or claim-expiry fact.
